name: Summer Festival
description_short: The city's outdoor summer program at Hopewell Park for Taunton children, with swimming at Hopewell Pool, sports, crafts, games and a field trip each week. Breakfast and lunch are served, and it moves to the former Coyle and Cassidy gym on rainy days.

sessions.name: Week 2 (trip: Frog Pond and Swan Boats, Boston)
Week 6 (trip: Colt State Park, Bristol RI)
Week 7 (trip: Canobie Lake Park, Salem NH)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. City of Taunton summer page, 2026 section for Taunton Parks and Recreation; says Summer Festival registration is full and links MyRec for registration

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Parks and Recreation flyer: July 6 to August 21, 2026, 9am to 3pm, ages 5-12 (at least 5 by June 1, 2026), 150 children per week; $160 per week, non-residents $200 per week after May 1 if space allows; morning care 6:45 to 8:30am $30, after care 3:30 to 5:15pm $35, both $40 per week; 50 grant scholarships a week at $80 for income-eligible Taunton families; breakfast and lunch through the USDA Summer Food Program. ZIP is the department's own (170 Harris Street, Taunton MA 02780); the flyer gives no street address for Hopewell Park

warnings: 2026 registration was full; residents first, non-residents after May 1 if space allows
